snippet.title: Liquor Store Simulator - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Liquor Store Simulator is out now! 🍺🛒

Open your own Liquor Store! Buy goods, manage your store, hire staff. Who knows, maybe you will be able to make a real alcohol empire out of a small store.

Play now!
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3124550/Liquor_Store_Simulator
